messages:
sophia: quick follow-up on the host-backed pages RFC — a couple of open questions about coherency and lifecycle between the allocator and the OS. want to sync before the next iteration.

mike: +1. main worry is stale writeback with async kernels. if GPU writes and we page out on host, who does the flush? :thinking:

dan: can we rely on explicit cupy/torch memcpy sync points? i.e., require callers to signal when a buffer is dirty so the allocator can mark it.

sophia: ideally we avoid changing every caller. prefer allocator-led tracking: track last-writer epoch and expose a small API for drivers to signal kernel completion. short patch to runtime.

arya: what about mmap + madvise(DONTNEED) style reclaim? OS might drop pages, then GPU access faults — we need a predictable fallback path.

mike: fallback options: 1) proactive writeback on reclaim (sync+pages to host), 2) trap and migrate on fault (page-in on fault), 3) pin-on-alloc heavy-hitter pages. each has perf/cost tradeoffs.

lee: short log from yesterday's repro: ``[evict] page 0x7f8b9a: dirty=1 last_writer_epoch=42 reclaimed -> stalling kernel 34ms while copying``. shows pauses when we do synchronous writeback.

sophia: ok so design constraint: minimize 99th tail for small requests (<1k tokens) but allow heavier pauses for large background GC. suggests two-tier policy: interactive pages (pin+no-evict) vs bulk pages (lazy offload with best-effort writeback).

dan: API idea: allocator exposes reserve(path, flags) and release(path, flags) and an async notify_dirty(handle, epoch). runtime-bot: deploy-check :white_check_mark: - add tests for cross-device kernel-visible dirty bits.

mike: about migration: do we have infra to page-in synchronously from host to GPU memory without stalling scheduler? can stream copy and let kernel wait on event. need a nonblocking prefetch path.

sophia: agree. plan: implement a migration worker that attempts prefetch when heuristics predict reuse, otherwise fallback to sync-copy on fault. i'll draft a concrete API and add microbenchmarks (prefetch hit rate vs added memcopy).

arya: nit: add a metric for "pages prefetched" and "prefetch evicted before use" so we can tune heuristics.

lee: also add a mode flag for "strict-coherent" for enterprise customers who prefer correctness over perf — forces writeback-on-evict.

mike: SGTM. can we schedule a 30min follow-up tomorrow to agree API shapes?

sophia: scheduled. I'll push a minimal patch with the allocator notify API + runtime staging worker. please comment on the PR when it's up. :rocket:
